result.reason: The operative language meets every preferred requirement and therefore also exceeds the fallback E&O and cyber minimums. It is not minimal because it additionally requires CGL, E&O, and cyber coverage for one year after the Term and broadens the cyber trigger to visitor data beyond the stated Customer Data condition. The original general-provisions language remains effective and no contradiction is introduced.
